scope: nonselectable TRAIN endpoint diagnostics; not outer development accuracy or independent confirmation
selection: lowest SHA256(stage72_diag_v1/ + sample_token), without seed or target dependence
checkpoint: fixed supervised endpoint, 8000 or the prescribed EXTRA11000
same_context: repeat final observed context in all four slots
zero_events: raw zero counts followed by frozen TRAIN normalization and sensor support
zero_geometry: zero evidence and validity channels; retain direct logits and actual arm gaps
pair_time_permutation: existing per-token seed-salted derangement applied to geometric time assignment and gaps only; direct content remains unchanged
translation_texture: final observed context; normalized zero-event padding; fixed sensor support; no change of scale
synthetic_or_clock_target_policy: no invented TTC targets or supervised objective for clock, repeated-context, zero-event or translation-only observations
posterior_export: all108 bins, finite TTC, geometry evidence/masks and encoder descriptor health
